articles.title: Behind the Label Lies a Longer and Stranger Chemical Story
articles.summary: A new review of textile chemistry challenges the assumption that natural fibers are always more environmentally friendly than synthetics. The study finds that the environmental cost of clothing depends more on dyes, finishes, and treatments used throughout production, wear, and disposal than on the fiber type itself. This raises concerns about pollution and sustainability in the textile industry, which is a major sector in India.

articles.title: Right to question not defiance, every dissent not a threat: SC judge
articles.summary: Supreme Court judge Ujjal Bhuyan emphasized that governments must listen to citizens and allow dissent, stating that questioning is a fundamental part of democracy. He argued that universities should encourage free thinking and that silencing disagreement undermines constitutional values. The judge highlighted that a democracy's strength is measured by its response to unpopular opinions. "Intolerance undermines the constitutional framework when disagreement is silenced or punished."

Intolerance undermines the constitutional framework when disagreement is silenced or punished. A democracy's maturity is shown by its response to unpopular or inconvenient opinions.

articles.title: IFF supports challenge to covert Ray-Ban Meta recording and disparagement
articles.summary: The Internet Freedom Foundation (IFF) has issued a legal notice against Meta, the manufacturer of Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses, alleging covert recording and disparagement. The glasses, marketed as fashion eyewear with hands-free filming, are designed to look like ordinary spectacles. IFF argues this raises serious privacy and surveillance concerns. The case highlights potential gaps in India's data protection framework regarding wearable technology.
articles.raw_summary: The legal notice is its case against Meta as the manufacturer of the device, not merely the host of the video. Ray-Ban Meta glasses are marketed as fashion eyewear with hands free filming, deliberately styled to be indistinguishable from ordinary spectacles.
